description: Tiered skill check results for GM reference. Each skill has easy, moderate, and hard outcomes describing what success at that difficulty reveals or achieves.

Perception.easy: Notice something is off — overturned furniture, unusual smells, or fresh marks on the floor.
Perception.moderate: Spot a concealed camera, hidden door seam, or a partially obscured weapon.
Perception.hard: Detect a tripwire, notice micro-expressions of deception on an NPC, or find a concealed compartment.

Streetwise.easy: Recognize the faction operating here from graffiti tags, uniform scraps, or equipment markings.
Streetwise.moderate: Identify the likely leader, know the local black market rates, or recognize a known criminal.
Streetwise.hard: Know the faction"s current internal politics, identify a disguised operative, or predict their next move.

Skulduggery.easy: Pick a basic mechanical lock or notice a standard security system.
Skulduggery.moderate: Bypass an electronic lock, detect a concealed safe, or identify stolen goods.
Skulduggery.hard: Crack an encrypted security terminal, disarm a sophisticated trap, or forge credentials on the spot.

Computers.easy: Access an unlocked terminal and read recent messages or logs.
Computers.moderate: Slice a password-protected terminal, recover deleted files, or loop a security feed.
Computers.hard: Break Imperial-grade encryption, plant an untraceable data worm, or remotely control facility systems.

Vigilance.easy: Notice when the ambient noise changes or someone enters the room.
Vigilance.moderate: React to an ambush attempt — not surprised, but enemies get initiative advantage.
Vigilance.hard: Detect the ambush before it happens. The players get to act first.

Stealth.easy: Move through an unoccupied corridor without making noise.
Stealth.moderate: Slip past a guard post or patrol route with timing and patience.
Stealth.hard: Move through an occupied room undetected, or shadow a target through a crowded area.

Charm.easy: Get a neutral NPC to share publicly known information.
Charm.moderate: Convince a suspicious NPC to look the other way or share a minor secret.
Charm.hard: Turn a hostile NPC into a temporary ally, or extract classified information through conversation.

Coercion.easy: Intimidate a nervous civilian into cooperating.
Coercion.moderate: Force a trained guard to abandon their post or reveal patrol schedules.
Coercion.hard: Break a trained operative"s resolve, or cause an entire minion group to flee.

Mechanics.easy: Identify what a piece of equipment does or diagnose an obvious malfunction.
Mechanics.moderate: Jury-rig a broken system, disable a security device, or repair a damaged door mechanism.
Mechanics.hard: Reroute facility power systems, sabotage a vehicle for delayed failure, or build an improvised explosive.
